title: What happened to the Saints and Sinners after ten years
summary: After the 1969 trip the band kept going with a replacement for him but the regular club jobs dried up, and it played only occasionally.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Then you came -- you made one other trip in '69. You mentioned that, that you went to Europe again in '69. And then when you came back from that trip, you just worked mostly in the United States and Canada again?
Toronto and around that same circuit. And the band -- what happened to the band? You lasted ten years with it. Did it break up? Or what?

Well yeah, finally, yes. I was around, aw, I've been away from them now three, four years, and they put somebody else in my place, but they're still going, but not steady, not Pittsburgh, Columbus, Ohio, Cleveland, and all that stuff. They're not doing that. They're doing --
Well what happened to the band? It
worked pretty steadily for almost ten years.

Well there wasn't the jobs. It wasn't the band so much, I don't think, it's the jobs. I mean they couldn't afford the thing anymore, I mean because it was getting a pretty nice piece of money there, for one thing, and they -- well, they can't -- we can't do it. So they -- not only not having us, and not having practically anyone (unintelligible) they used smaller groups, no group, pianist or something.
These were places they used to play.
Yeah. One of those things, you know.
